# VÉRTICE: O Limiar da Existência — Projeto Godot 4.3 (Exclusivamente 2D · Capítulos I–VI · Android ARM64)

## 1. Arquitetura 100% 2D & Sistemas Implementados
- **Motor & Renderização (`project.godot` + `export_presets.cfg`)**: Godot 4.3 `gl_compatibility` / `mobile`, `arm64-v8a` apenas, `min_sdk 24`, `target_sdk 34`, meta de **30 FPS** com fallback automático de escala no **OPPO A5 (Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 1 / Adreno 619 / 6 GB RAM)**. Zero nós 3D em todo o projeto.
- **Física 2D Corrigida (`player.tscn` + `player_controller.gd` + `resonance_object.gd` + `checkpoint.gd`)**:
  - `CollisionShape2D` retangular plano (`18x52px`) com `floor_stop_on_slope = true`, `floor_constant_speed = true`, `floor_snap_length = 6.0` e `platform_on_leave = 2`.
  - Fricção em solo `4200.0`, corte de inércia horizontal no pouso (`*= 0.2`) quando sem input, plataformas móveis sincronizadas em `_physics_process` com `constant_linear_velocity` e ativação de checkpoint restrita a pouso real no solo.
- **Campanha Completa (Capítulos I a VI)**:
  - `world_chapter_1.tscn` (O Despertar)
  - `world_chapter_2_threshold.tscn` (O Chamado)
  - `world_chapter_3_city.tscn` (A Cidade Esquecida)
  - `world_chapter_4_abyss.tscn` (O Abismo das Memórias)
  - `world_chapter_5_convergence.tscn` (A Convergência)
  - `world_chapter_6_threshold.tscn` (O Limiar da Existência)
- **Mecânicas Adicionais**: Três estados de Ressonância (`PRESENTE`, `ECO`, `RUPTURA`) com guarda física anti-sobreposição (`ResonanceSystem.would_overlap_player`), agachar/furtividade (`crouch`), escalada em cordas/escadas (`ClimbZone`), blocos empurráveis (`PushBlock`), vegetação reativa (`VegetationCluster`), perigos (`HazardZone`) e 3 criaturas originais (`CreatureEntity`).

## 2. Como Compilar o APK Instalável
O contêiner atual não possui `godot` nem Android SDK/NDK instalados, portanto o binário `.apk` não foi compilado localmente aqui. O projeto já inclui um workflow automatizado em `.github/workflows/build_android_apk.yml` além das instruções manuais:

1. **Via GitHub Actions**: Ao enviar o repositório para o GitHub, execute o workflow manual/push `Build VÉRTICE Android APK` para gerar e baixar o artefato `VERTICE_Capitulo1_a_6.apk`.
2. **Localmente (Godot 4.3)**:
   - Instale o **Godot Engine 4.3** (Standard) e os **Export Templates 4.3**.
   - Instale **Android SDK (API 34)**, **Build-Tools 34.0.0**, **NDK r23c+** e **OpenJDK 17**.
   - Configure `Editor > Editor Settings > Export > Android` (Android SDK + `debug.keystore`).
   - Abra `VERTICE/project.godot` e execute `Project > Export... > Android > Export Project...` (`android/build/VERTICE_Capitulo1_a_6.apk`).
   - Instale no **OPPO A5** com `adb install -r VERTICE_Capitulo1_a_6.apk`.

# Configuração Android & Perfil OPPO A5 — VÉRTICE

- **Dispositivo de referência**: OPPO A5 / Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 1 / Adreno 619 / 6 GB RAM.
- **Renderer**: `gl_compatibility` (OpenGL ES 3.0 mobile) para máxima estabilidade térmica e zero stutters de compilação de shaders Vulkan em GPUs intermediárias.
- **Meta de desempenho**: 30 FPS estáveis no perfil padrão (`Engine.max_fps = 30`), com opção de 60 FPS no menu de qualidade.
- **Técnicas de otimização aplicadas**:
  - Shaders single-pass (`volumetric_fog.gdshader` e `resonance_shift.gdshader`) sem post-processing multi-pass ou glow fullscreen pesado.
  - Iluminação 2D simulada por gradiente aditivo (`core_glow.gdshader`) em vez de `PointLight2D` com shadow casters caros.
  - Compressão VRAM ETC2/ASTC habilitada em `project.godot`.
  - Controles touchscreen dedicados com área mínima >= 64px e ajuste de sensibilidade persistido em `user://vertice_save.json`.

# Protagonista humano adulto em 2D articulado: cinemática inversa, capa de 7 nós, agachar, escalar, empurrar e dissolução
var _time: float = 0.0
var _walk_cycle: float = 0.0
var _squash: Vector2 = Vector2.ONE
var _facing: float = 1.0
var _flare_timer: float = 0.0
var _reject_timer: float = 0.0
var _interact_timer: float = 0.0
var _land_crouch: float = 0.0
var _awaken_progress: float = 1.0
var _dying_progress: float = 0.0
var _is_dying: bool = false
var _cloak_nodes: Array[Vector2] = []

var _torso_poly: Polygon2D
var _collar_poly: Polygon2D
var _head_poly: Polygon2D
var _cloak_poly: Polygon2D
var _leg_l: Line2D
var _leg_r: Line2D
var _arm_l: Line2D
var _arm_r: Line2D
var _core_sprite: Sprite2D
var _core_light: PointLight2D

func _ready() -> void:
	for i in range(7):
		_cloak_nodes.append(Vector2(-float(i) * 3.2, -34.0 + float(i) * 3.8))
	_build_articulated_2d_body()

func _build_articulated_2d_body() -> void:
	_cloak_poly = Polygon2D.new()
	_cloak_poly.color = Color(0.05, 0.06, 0.078, 0.96)
	add_child(_cloak_poly)

	_leg_l = Line2D.new()
	_leg_l.width = 4.2
	_leg_l.default_color = Color(0.04, 0.048, 0.062, 1.0)
	_leg_l.joint_mode = Line2D.LINE_JOINT_ROUND
	_leg_l.begin_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	_leg_l.end_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	add_child(_leg_l)

	_leg_r = Line2D.new()
	_leg_r.width = 4.4
	_leg_r.default_color = Color(0.065, 0.075, 0.095, 1.0)
	_leg_r.joint_mode = Line2D.LINE_JOINT_ROUND
	_leg_r.begin_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	_leg_r.end_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	add_child(_leg_r)

	_arm_l = Line2D.new()
	_arm_l.width = 3.2
	_arm_l.default_color = Color(0.045, 0.052, 0.068, 1.0)
	_arm_l.joint_mode = Line2D.LINE_JOINT_ROUND
	_arm_l.begin_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	_arm_l.end_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	add_child(_arm_l)

	_torso_poly = Polygon2D.new()
	_torso_poly.color = Color(0.085, 0.096, 0.12, 1.0)
	_torso_poly.polygon = PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(-5.8, -39), Vector2(5.8, -39),
		Vector2(4.4, -20), Vector2(-4.4, -20)
	])
	add_child(_torso_poly)

	_collar_poly = Polygon2D.new()
	_collar_poly.color = Color(0.11, 0.125, 0.155, 1.0)
	_collar_poly.polygon = PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(-5.5, -41), Vector2(4.2, -41),
		Vector2(4.2, -38), Vector2(-5.5, -38)
	])
	add_child(_collar_poly)

	_head_poly = Polygon2D.new()
	_head_poly.color = Color(0.11, 0.12, 0.145, 1.0)
	var head_pts := PackedVector2Array()
	for i in range(10):
		var a := float(i) * TAU / 10.0
		head_pts.append(Vector2(cos(a) * 4.8, -46.5 + sin(a) * 5.6))
	_head_poly.polygon = head_pts
	add_child(_head_poly)

	_arm_r = Line2D.new()
	_arm_r.width = 3.4
	_arm_r.default_color = Color(0.095, 0.105, 0.13, 1.0)
	_arm_r.joint_mode = Line2D.LINE_JOINT_ROUND
	_arm_r.begin_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	_arm_r.end_cap_mode = Line2D.LINE_CAP_ROUND
	add_child(_arm_r)

	_core_sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	_core_sprite.texture = TextureFactory2D.tex_core_glow
	_core_sprite.position = Vector2(2.4, -32.0)
	_core_sprite.scale = Vector2(0.38, 0.38)
	add_child(_core_sprite)

	_core_light = PointLight2D.new()
	_core_light.texture = TextureFactory2D.tex_core_glow
	_core_light.position = Vector2(2.4, -32.0)
	_core_light.color = Color(0.95, 0.64, 0.24, 1.0)
	_core_light.energy = 1.15
	_core_light.texture_scale = 3.6
	add_child(_core_light)

func _solve_ik(origin: Vector2, target: Vector2, l1: float, l2: float, bend_sign: float) -> Vector2:
	var delta := target - origin
	var max_reach := l1 + l2 - 0.35
	var min_reach := absf(l1 - l2) + 0.35
	var dist := clampf(delta.length(), min_reach, max_reach)
	var cos_a := clampf((l1 * l1 + dist * dist - l2 * l2) / (2.0 * l1 * dist), -1.0, 1.0)
	var base_ang := delta.angle()
	var joint_ang := base_ang + bend_sign * acos(cos_a)
	return origin + Vector2(cos(joint_ang), sin(joint_ang)) * l1

func update_motion(
	velocity: Vector2,
	on_floor: bool,
	facing: float,
	is_running: bool,
	is_crouching: bool = false,
	is_climbing: bool = false,
	is_pushing: bool = false,
	delta: float = 0.016
) -> void:
	_time += delta
	_facing = facing
	_flare_timer = maxf(0.0, _flare_timer - delta * 2.2)
	_reject_timer = maxf(0.0, _reject_timer - delta)
	_interact_timer = maxf(0.0, _interact_timer - delta * 3.0)
	_land_crouch = maxf(0.0, _land_crouch - delta * 5.2)
	if _awaken_progress < 1.0:
		_awaken_progress = minf(1.0, _awaken_progress + delta * 0.62)
	if _is_dying:
		_dying_progress = minf(1.0, _dying_progress + delta * 1.25)
	else:
		_dying_progress = maxf(0.0, _dying_progress - delta * 3.0)
	modulate.a = clampf(1.0 - _dying_progress * 0.85, 0.15, 1.0)
	_squash = _squash.lerp(Vector2.ONE, clampf(14.0 * delta, 0.0, 1.0))

	var speed := absf(velocity.x)
	var speed_ratio := clampf(speed / 345.0, 0.0, 1.0)
	if is_climbing and absf(velocity.y) > 10.0:
		_walk_cycle += delta * 7.2
	elif on_floor and speed > 15.0:
		_walk_cycle += delta * (9.5 if is_running else 6.4) * (0.4 + speed_ratio * 0.8)

	var base_lean := 0.0 if is_climbing else ((0.1 if is_running else (0.16 if is_pushing else 0.05)) * speed_ratio if on_floor else clampf(velocity.y * 0.00025, -0.15, 0.15))
	var awaken_lean := (1.0 - _awaken_progress) * 0.28
	scale = Vector2(_facing * _squash.x, _squash.y)
	rotation = lerpf(rotation, (base_lean + awaken_lean) * _facing, 12.0 * delta)

	var breathe := sin(_time * 2.2) * 1.1 if speed < 15.0 else absf(sin(_walk_cycle * 2.0)) * 1.6
	var crouch_drop := (11.5 if is_crouching else 0.0) + _land_crouch * 6.5 + (1.0 - _awaken_progress) * 14.5
	var hip_y := -21.5 + crouch_drop + breathe * 0.35
	var sh_y := -39.0 + crouch_drop * 0.92 + breathe * 0.55

	var stride := sin(_walk_cycle) * (10.5 if is_running else 7.2) * speed_ratio
	var lift_l := maxf(0.0, cos(_walk_cycle)) * (6.2 if is_running else 4.2) * speed_ratio
	var lift_r := maxf(0.0, -cos(_walk_cycle)) * (6.2 if is_running else 4.2) * speed_ratio

	if _awaken_progress < 0.96:
		var hip_l := Vector2(-2.0, hip_y)
		var foot_l := Vector2(-9.0, -1.0)
		_leg_l.points = PackedVector2Array([hip_l, _solve_ik(hip_l, foot_l, 11.5, 11.5, 1.0), foot_l, foot_l + Vector2(3.5, 0.2)])
		var hip_r := Vector2(2.0, hip_y)
		var foot_r := Vector2(7.0, 0.0)
		_leg_r.points = PackedVector2Array([hip_r, _solve_ik(hip_r, foot_r, 11.5, 11.5, -1.0), foot_r, foot_r + Vector2(3.8, 0.2)])
	elif is_climbing:
		var alt := sin(_walk_cycle) * 5.0
		var hip_l := Vector2(-1.5, hip_y)
		var foot_l := Vector2(2.0, -2.0 + alt)
		_leg_l.points = PackedVector2Array([hip_l, _solve_ik(hip_l, foot_l, 11.8, 11.8, -1.0), foot_l, foot_l + Vector2(3.8, 0.2)])
		var hip_r := Vector2(1.5, hip_y)
		var foot_r := Vector2(4.0, -2.0 - alt)
		_leg_r.points = PackedVector2Array([hip_r, _solve_ik(hip_r, foot_r, 11.8, 11.8, -1.0), foot_r, foot_r + Vector2(3.8, 0.2)])
	elif on_floor:
		var hip_l := Vector2(-1.5, hip_y)
		var foot_l := Vector2(-stride, -lift_l)
		_leg_l.points = PackedVector2Array([hip_l, _solve_ik(hip_l, foot_l, 11.8, 11.8, -1.0), foot_l, foot_l + Vector2(3.8, 0.2)])
		var hip_r := Vector2(1.5, hip_y)
		var foot_r := Vector2(stride, -lift_r)
		_leg_r.points = PackedVector2Array([hip_r, _solve_ik(hip_r, foot_r, 11.8, 11.8, -1.0), foot_r, foot_r + Vector2(3.8, 0.2)])
	else:
		var air_tuck := clampf(-velocity.y * 0.01, -3.5, 5.5)
		var hip_l := Vector2(-2.0, hip_y)
		var foot_l := Vector2(-6.5, -3.5 - air_tuck)
		_leg_l.points = PackedVector2Array([hip_l, _solve_ik(hip_l, foot_l, 11.8, 11.8, -1.0), foot_l, foot_l + Vector2(3.5, 0.2)])
		var hip_r := Vector2(2.0, hip_y)
		var foot_r := Vector2(4.2, -4.5 - air_tuck)
		_leg_r.points = PackedVector2Array([hip_r, _solve_ik(hip_r, foot_r, 11.8, 11.8, -1.0), foot_r, foot_r + Vector2(3.5, 0.2)])

	var reach := _interact_timer * 10.5
	var awaken_brace := (1.0 - _awaken_progress) * 9.0
	var arm_swing := sin(_walk_cycle) * (7.0 if is_climbing else (9.0 if is_running else 6.2)) * (1.0 if is_climbing else speed_ratio)
	var sh_l := Vector2(-2.0, sh_y + 2.0)
	var hand_l := Vector2(9.0 if is_pushing else (4.0 if is_climbing else -3.0 - arm_swing), sh_y + (6.0 if is_pushing else (-6.0 + arm_swing if is_climbing else 17.5)))
	_arm_l.points = PackedVector2Array([sh_l, _solve_ik(sh_l, hand_l, 9.5, 9.5, 1.0), hand_l])

	var sh_r := Vector2(2.0, sh_y + 2.0)
	var hand_r := Vector2(11.0 if is_pushing else (4.0 if is_climbing else 3.0 + arm_swing + reach + awaken_brace * 0.6), sh_y + (5.0 if is_pushing else (-6.0 - arm_swing if is_climbing else 17.5 - reach * 0.65 + awaken_brace * 0.35)))
	_arm_r.points = PackedVector2Array([sh_r, _solve_ik(sh_r, hand_r, 9.5, 9.5, 1.0), hand_r])

	_torso_poly.position.y = crouch_drop * 0.92 + breathe * 0.55
	_collar_poly.position.y = _torso_poly.position.y
	_head_poly.position = Vector2(speed_ratio * 1.4, _torso_poly.position.y)

	_cloak_nodes[0] = Vector2(-4.5, sh_y + 2.0)
	var local_wind := -speed * 0.032 - 4.5
	var air_lift := 0.0 if on_floor else clampf(-velocity.y * 0.012, -3.5, 5.5)
	for i in range(1, _cloak_nodes.size()):
		var prev := _cloak_nodes[i - 1]
		var wave := sin(_time * 5.8 + float(i) * 0.85) * (1.0 + float(i) * 0.22)
		var target := Vector2(prev.x + local_wind * 0.5 + wave, prev.y + 4.3 + air_lift * 0.35)
		_cloak_nodes[i] = _cloak_nodes[i].lerp(target, clampf((18.0 - float(i)) * delta, 0.0, 1.0))

	var cloak_pts := PackedVector2Array()
	for i in range(_cloak_nodes.size()):
		cloak_pts.append(_cloak_nodes[i])
	for i in range(_cloak_nodes.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		var pt := _cloak_nodes[i]
		cloak_pts.append(Vector2(pt.x - (3.5 + float(i) * 1.85), pt.y + 8.5 + float(i) * 1.9))
	_cloak_poly.polygon = cloak_pts

	var state := ResonanceSystem.current_state
	var pulse := 1.0 + 0.14 * sin(_time * 2.8)
	var core_col := Color(0.95, 0.64, 0.24, 1.0)
	if state == ResonanceSystem.State.ECO:
		pulse = 1.0 + 0.2 * sin(_time * 4.5)
		core_col = Color(1.0, 0.76, 0.36, 1.0)
	elif state == ResonanceSystem.State.RUPTURA:
		pulse = 1.0 + 0.28 * sin(_time * 8.2)
		core_col = Color(1.0, 0.48, 0.18, 1.0)
	if _reject_timer > 0.0:
		core_col = Color(1.0, 0.34, 0.24, 1.0)

	var flare_boost := (1.0 + _flare_timer * 1.25) * (0.45 + 0.55 * _awaken_progress)
	_core_sprite.position = Vector2(2.6, sh_y + 6.5)
	_core_sprite.scale = Vector2.ONE * (0.36 * pulse * flare_boost)
	_core_sprite.modulate = core_col
	_core_light.position = _core_sprite.position
	_core_light.color = core_col
	_core_light.energy = (1.1 + 0.25 * (pulse - 1.0)) * flare_boost

func start_awaken() -> void:
	_awaken_progress = 0.0

func is_awakening() -> bool:
	return _awaken_progress < 0.36

func start_dying() -> void:
	_is_dying = true
	_dying_progress = 0.0

func end_dying() -> void:
	_is_dying = false
	_dying_progress = 0.0
	modulate.a = 1.0

func trigger_jump_stretch() -> void:
	_squash = Vector2(0.84, 1.18)
	_land_crouch = 0.0

func trigger_land_squash(heavy: bool = false) -> void:
	_squash = Vector2(1.22, 0.78) if heavy else Vector2(1.14, 0.86)
	_land_crouch = 1.0 if heavy else 0.55

func trigger_turn_skid() -> void:
	_squash = Vector2(1.09, 0.93)

func trigger_resonance_flare() -> void:
	_flare_timer = 1.0

func trigger_resonance_reject() -> void:
	_reject_timer = 0.45

func trigger_interact() -> void:
	_interact_timer = 1.0

var ambient_player: AudioStreamPlayer
var sfx_player: AudioStreamPlayer

var master_volume: float = 0.85
var is_muted: bool = false

var _sounds: Dictionary = {}

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	ambient_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	sfx_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	add_child(ambient_player)
	add_child(sfx_player)

	_load_streams()
	master_volume = float(SaveManager.data.get("master_volume", 0.85))
	is_muted = bool(SaveManager.data.get("muted", false))
	apply_volume()

	if _sounds.has("ambient"):
		ambient_player.stream = _sounds["ambient"]
		ambient_player.play()

func _load_streams() -> void:
	var paths := {
		"ambient": "res://audio/ambient_drone.wav",
		"jump": "res://audio/sfx_jump.wav",
		"land": "res://audio/sfx_land.wav",
		"echo": "res://audio/sfx_echo.wav",
		"ruptura": "res://audio/sfx_ruptura.wav",
		"presente": "res://audio/sfx_presente.wav",
		"checkpoint": "res://audio/sfx_checkpoint.wav"
	}
	for key in paths.keys():
		if ResourceLoader.exists(paths[key]):
			_sounds[key] = load(paths[key])

func apply_volume() -> void:
	var linear := 0.0 if is_muted else master_volume
	var db := linear_to_db(maxf(0.0001, linear))
	ambient_player.volume_db = db - 6.0
	sfx_player.volume_db = db

func set_master_volume(val: float) -> void:
	master_volume = clampf(val, 0.0, 1.0)
	apply_volume()

func set_muted(muted: bool) -> void:
	is_muted = muted
	apply_volume()

func set_chapter_mood(chapter_num: int) -> void:
	if ambient_player:
		var pitches := {1: 1.0, 2: 0.94, 3: 0.9, 4: 0.86, 5: 1.04, 6: 1.12}
		ambient_player.pitch_scale = float(pitches.get(chapter_num, 1.0))

func play_sfx(sound_name: String, pitch: float = 1.0) -> void:
	if is_muted or not _sounds.has(sound_name):
		return
	sfx_player.stream = _sounds[sound_name]
	sfx_player.pitch_scale = pitch
	sfx_player.play()

func play_spatial_sfx(sound_name: String, world_pos: Vector2, pitch: float = 1.0) -> void:
	if is_muted or not _sounds.has(sound_name):
		return
	var p := AudioStreamPlayer2D.new()
	p.stream = _sounds[sound_name]
	p.pitch_scale = pitch
	p.volume_db = linear_to_db(maxf(0.0001, master_volume))
	p.max_distance = 1200.0
	p.global_position = world_pos
	var root := get_tree().current_scene
	if root:
		root.add_child(p)
		p.finished.connect(p.queue_free)
		p.play()

func play_resonance_transition(state_id: int) -> void:
	match state_id:
		0:
			play_sfx("presente", 1.0)
		1:
			play_sfx("echo", 1.0)
		2:
			play_sfx("ruptura", 0.96)

var current_chapter: int = 1

var _low_fps_timer: float = 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	apply_quality(SaveManager.data.get("quality", QualityLevel.MEDIUM))

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_paused or current_quality == QualityLevel.LOW or _auto_scaled_once:
		return
	var fps := Engine.get_frames_per_second()
	if fps > 0 and fps < 24.0:
		_low_fps_timer += delta
		if _low_fps_timer >= 2.5:
			_auto_scaled_once = true
			apply_quality(current_quality - 1)
			emit_signal("auto_quality_adjusted", current_quality)
	else:
		_low_fps_timer = 0.0

func start_new_game() -> void:
	ChapterProgression.reset_progression()
	SaveManager.reset_progress()
	ResonanceSystem.reset_states()
	current_chapter = 1
	in_chapter_2 = false
	just_started_chapter = true
	active_checkpoint_id = "cp_area_1"
	active_checkpoint_pos = Vector2(160.0, 420.0)
	current_area = 1
	chapter_finished = false
	get_tree().paused = false
	is_paused = false
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file(ChapterProgression.get_scene_path(1))

func start_chapter(chapter_num: int) -> void:
	var chap := clampi(chapter_num, 1, 6)
	current_chapter = chap
	in_chapter_2 = (chap == 2)
	just_started_chapter = true
	chapter_finished = false
	current_area = (chap - 1) * 5 + 1
	active_checkpoint_id = "cp_area_1" if chap == 1 else "cp_c%d_area_1" % chap
	active_checkpoint_pos = Vector2(160.0, 420.0 if chap == 1 else 410.0)
	ResonanceSystem.prepare_chapter(chap)
	SaveManager.save_progress()
	get_tree().paused = false
	is_paused = false
	var scene_path := ChapterProgression.get_scene_path(chap)
	if ResourceLoader.exists(scene_path):
		get_tree().change_scene_to_file(scene_path)

func start_chapter_2() -> void:
	start_chapter(2)

func advance_to_next_chapter() -> void:
	if current_chapter < 6:
		start_chapter(current_chapter + 1)
	else:
		start_chapter(6)

func continue_game() -> void:
	SaveManager.load_all()
	var saved := SaveManager.data
	ChapterProgression.load_from_save(saved)
	current_chapter = clampi(int(saved.get("chapter_number", 1)), 1, 6)
	in_chapter_2 = (current_chapter == 2)
	just_started_chapter = false
	active_checkpoint_id = str(saved.get("checkpoint_id", "cp_area_1" if current_chapter == 1 else "cp_c%d_area_1" % current_chapter))
	var default_y := 420.0 if current_chapter == 1 else 410.0
	var pos_dict: Dictionary = saved.get("checkpoint_pos", {"x": 160.0, "y": default_y})
	active_checkpoint_pos = Vector2(
		float(pos_dict.get("x", 160.0)),
		float(pos_dict.get("y", default_y))
	)
	var min_area := (current_chapter - 1) * 5 + 1
	var max_area := min_area + 4
	current_area = clampi(int(saved.get("area_id", min_area)), min_area, max_area)
	ResonanceSystem.restore_from_save(saved)
	chapter_finished = false
	get_tree().paused = false
	is_paused = false
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file(ChapterProgression.get_scene_path(current_chapter))

func return_to_main_menu() -> void:
	is_paused = false
	chapter_finished = false
	in_chapter_2 = false
	get_tree().paused = false
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/main.tscn")

func set_area(area_id: int) -> void:
	if current_area == area_id:
		return
	current_area = clampi(area_id, 1, 30)
	var info: Dictionary = AREAS.get(current_area, AREAS[1])
	emit_signal("area_changed", current_area, info["title"], info["subtitle"])
	SaveManager.save_progress()

func register_checkpoint(cp_id: String, pos: Vector2, area_id: int) -> void:
	active_checkpoint_id = cp_id
	active_checkpoint_pos = pos
	current_area = area_id
	SaveManager.save_progress()

func toggle_pause() -> void:
	if chapter_finished:
		return
	is_paused = not is_paused
	get_tree().paused = is_paused

func apply_quality(level: int) -> void:
	current_quality = clampi(level, QualityLevel.LOW, QualityLevel.HIGH)
	var vp := get_viewport()
	match current_quality:
		QualityLevel.LOW:
			Engine.max_fps = 30
			if vp:
				vp.content_scale_factor = 0.82
		QualityLevel.MEDIUM:
			Engine.max_fps = 30
			if vp:
				vp.content_scale_factor = 1.0
		QualityLevel.HIGH:
			Engine.max_fps = 60
			if vp:
				vp.content_scale_factor = 1.0
	emit_signal("quality_changed", current_quality)

func complete_chapter() -> void:
	if chapter_finished:
		return
	chapter_finished = true
	is_paused = true
	get_tree().paused = true
	ChapterProgression.mark_chapter_completed(current_chapter)
	emit_signal("chapter_completed")

func request_cinematic_focus(world_pos: Vector2, target_zoom: float, duration: float, use_letterbox: bool = true) -> void:
	emit_signal("cinematic_focus_requested", world_pos, target_zoom, duration, use_letterbox)

	"has_save": false,
	"chapter_number": 1,
	"unlocked_chapter": 1,
	"completed_chapters": [],
	"area_id": 1,
	"checkpoint_id": "cp_area_1",

	"puzzle_bridge_locked": false,

	"chapter_2_completed": false,
	"discovered_memories": [],
	"master_volume": 0.85,
	"muted": false,

	"quality": 1
}

func _ready() -> void:
	load_all()

func has_saved_game() -> bool:
	return bool(data.get("has_save", false))

func load_all() -> void:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(SAVE_PATH):
		return
	var file := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return
	var parsed = JSON.parse_string(file.get_as_text())
	if typeof(parsed) == TYPE_DICTIONARY:
		for k in parsed.keys():
			data[k] = parsed[k]

func save_progress() -> void:
	data["has_save"] = true
	data["chapter_number"] = clampi(GameManager.current_chapter, 1, 6)
	data["area_id"] = GameManager.current_area
	data["checkpoint_id"] = GameManager.active_checkpoint_id
	data["checkpoint_pos"] = {
		"x": GameManager.active_checkpoint_pos.x,
		"y": GameManager.active_checkpoint_pos.y
	}
	data["unlocked_echo"] = ResonanceSystem.unlocked_echo
	data["unlocked_ruptura"] = ResonanceSystem.unlocked_ruptura
	data["resonance_state"] = ResonanceSystem.current_state
	data["ruptura_energy"] = ResonanceSystem.ruptura_energy
	data["frequency_switch_active"] = ResonanceSystem.frequency_switch_active
	var active_anchors: Array[String] = []
	for key in ResonanceSystem.puzzle_anchors.keys():
		if ResonanceSystem.puzzle_anchors[key]:
			active_anchors.append(str(key))
	data["puzzle_anchors"] = active_anchors
	data["puzzle_bridge_locked"] = ResonanceSystem.puzzle_bridge_locked
	data["quality"] = GameManager.current_quality
	var chap := ChapterProgression.serialize()
	data["unlocked_chapter"] = chap["unlocked_chapter"]
	data["completed_chapters"] = chap["completed_chapters"]
	data["chapter_1_completed"] = chap["chapter_1_completed"]
	data["chapter_2_completed"] = chap["chapter_2_completed"]
	data["discovered_memories"] = chap["discovered_memories"]
	_write_file()

func save_settings(volume: float, muted: bool, sensitivity: float, quality: int) -> void:
	data["master_volume"] = clampf(volume, 0.0, 1.0)
	data["muted"] = muted
	data["touch_sensitivity"] = clampf(sensitivity, 0.5, 2.0)
	data["quality"] = clampi(quality, 0, 2)
	_write_file()

func reset_progress() -> void:
	data["has_save"] = false
	data["chapter_number"] = 1
	data["unlocked_chapter"] = 1
	data["completed_chapters"] = []
	data["area_id"] = 1
	data["checkpoint_id"] = "cp_area_1"
	data["checkpoint_pos"] = {"x": 160.0, "y": 420.0}
	data["unlocked_echo"] = false
	data["unlocked_ruptura"] = false
	data["resonance_state"] = 0
	data["ruptura_energy"] = 1.0
	data["frequency_switch_active"] = false
	data["puzzle_anchors"] = []
	data["puzzle_bridge_locked"] = false
	data["chapter_1_completed"] = false
	data["chapter_2_completed"] = false
	data["discovered_memories"] = []
	_write_file()

func _write_file() -> void:
	var file := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		return
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(data, "\t"))

name: Build VÉRTICE Android APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'VERTICE/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build_android_apk.yml'

jobs:
  build-android-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Install Android SDK 34 & Build Tools
        run: |
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses || true
          sdkmanager "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0" "ndk;23.2.8568313"

      - name: Download Godot 4.3 Linux & Export Templates
        run: |
          wget -q https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.3-stable/Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip
          unzip -q Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip
          chmod +x Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64
          wget -q https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.3-stable/Godot_v4.3-stable_export_templates.tpz
          mkdir -p ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.3.stable
          unzip -q Godot_v4.3-stable_export_templates.tpz -d /tmp/templates
          mv /tmp/templates/templates/* ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.3.stable/

      - name: Generate Debug Keystore
        run: |
          keytool -genkey -v -keystore /tmp/debug.keystore -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey -keypass android -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US"

      - name: Run Godot Headless Sanity Test
        run: |
          ./Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64 --headless --path VERTICE -s res://tests/test_physics_and_campaign.gd

      - name: Export Android ARM64 APK
        run: |
          mkdir -p VERTICE/android/build
          ./Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64 --headless --path VERTICE --export-debug "Android" android/build/VERTICE_Capitulo1_a_6.apk

      - name: Upload APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: VERTICE-Android-ARM64-APK
          path: VERTICE/android/build/VERTICE_Capitulo1_a_6.apk
